overview_description.description: PatientPing is a health technology company that is building a national network of engaged providers who are sharing information, coordinating care, and working together to get patients healthier faster. PatientPing connects healthcare providers across the country with real-time notifications and care guidelines whenever and wherever their patients receive care. PatientPing's national care coordination network includes physicians, nurses, case managers, and care coordinators across hospitals, emergency departments, accountable care organizations (ACOs), physician practices, skilled nursing facilities, home health agencies, inpatient rehabilitation centers, and payers. By connecting care teams through real-time information sharing, PatientPing enables providers to deliver higher quality and more cost-effective care, improving patient outcomes, and experience.

product.name: Pings
product.description: A real-time notification system providing alerts on patient care transitions using admission, discharge, and transfer data to improve care coordination and outcomes.

product.name: Real-Time Care Intelligence
product.description: Provides real-time patient data to improve decision-making and care coordination across healthcare settings.

product.name: Care Collaboration Network
product.description: Connects healthcare providers, payers, and care teams to enhance communication and patient care.

product.name: Patient Tracking and Alerts
product.description: Delivers real-time alerts to healthcare providers about patient encounters to improve decision-making and care transitions.

product.name: Patient Alerts
product.description: Sends real-time notifications to physicians about patient interactions with other providers.

product.name: Prescription Drug Monitoring Program (PDMP) Integration
product.description: Integrates controlled substance use data into pharmacy management systems to enhance patient safety and compliance.
